title: CredentialStoreError missing #[non_exhaustive] — adding a variant is breaking
description: stoa-auth is a library crate; CredentialStoreError is pub and re-exported in lib.rs. Without #[non_exhaustive], adding any future variant (e.g. PermissionDenied, TooLarge) is a semver-breaking change for callers that exhaustively match on the error. reader::ConfigError and imap::ConfigError both have #[non_exhaustive]; CredentialStoreError should too.
